title: ⚔️ Iron Sharpens Iron — Men’s Bible Fellowship
seo_title: Iron Sharpens Iron Men's Bible Fellowship in Bolivar, MO
description: Iron Sharpens Iron is a weekly men's Bible fellowship where men open the Bible together, ask questions, talk about real life, and encourage one another. The group is currently working through the Book of Matthew, and it is not a class, so no Bible expertise or specific church membership is needed. It takes place on November 19, 2026 (Time TBD) at 1300 East 466th Road in Bolivar, Missouri.
